work.name: Coinboot
work.summary: Developed Coinboot - a lightweight framework for diskless GPU computing
highlights: Based on my experience with the setup and operations of huge GPU clusters for cryptographic hashing I created Coinboot
Coinboot has a lightweight footprint (105 MB boot image) driven by the demand to run sufficiently on thousands of machines with commditity 1 Gbit/s network hardware.
Coinboot uses network booting and is running diskless without any need for local storage media, it enables to run immutable infrastructure with no configuration drift, minimizing the TCO.
Coinboot was deployed to over 35k nodes with 270k GPUs in total at datacenters worldwide.
